sloka: रंस्यते तत्र वैदेही लक्ष्मणः च त्वया सह ।स हि रम्यो वनोउद्देशो बहु पादप संयुतः ॥३-११-४२॥
transliteration: raṁsyate tatra vaidehī lakṣmaṇaḥ ca tvayā saha ।sa hi ramyo vanouddeśo bahu pādapa saṁyutaḥ ॥3-11-42॥

translations.english: If you go in the southern direction for a yojana you will find Agasthya's hermitage by the side of a cluster of trees.
